name: Loving Thy Neighbor
overview: Scripture commands believers to love their neighbors as themselves, emphasizing this as a foundational principle given by the LORD (Leviticus 19:18) and reiterated by Jesus as the second greatest commandment (Matthew 22:39; Mark 12:31). This love is active and practical, demonstrated by treating others as we desire to be treated (Matthew 7:12) and by doing no harm to them, fulfilling the law through love (Romans 13:10). Loving thy neighbor is thus central to living out God’s law in obedience and grace.
